ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, where $ \angle BAC=90^\circ$, the medians $ AD$ and $ BE$ intersect at point F, and $ EG \parallel BC$ intersects $ AD$ at point G. Given that $ GF=2$, what is the length of $ BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $AD$ and $BE$ be the medians intersecting at point $F$, \\
$\therefore$ Point $F$ is the centroid of $\triangle ABC$, and $BD=CD$, \\
$\therefore$ $AF=2DF$, \\
$\because$ $EG\parallel BC$, \\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AGE\sim \triangle ADC$ \\
$\therefore$ $\frac{GE}{DC}=\frac{AE}{AC}=\frac{1}{2}$, \\
$\therefore$ $\frac{GE}{BD}=\frac{1}{2}$, \\
$\because$ $EG\parallel BC$, \\
$\therefore$ $\triangle GEF\sim \triangle DBF$, \\
$\therefore$ $\frac{DF}{GF}=\frac{BD}{EG}=2$, \\
$\therefore$ $DF=2GF=4$,\\
$\therefore$ $AF=2DF=8$, \\
$\therefore$ $AD=DF+AF=4+8=12$, \\
$\because$ $\angle BAC=90^\circ$, and $AD$ is the median of $\triangle ABC$, \\
$\therefore$ $BC=2AD=\boxed{24}$,

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle ABC, A is above, B and C are at the two ends of the base, and there is a right-angle mark at A, indicating ∠BAC=90°. Segment AD connects from A to point D on the base BC; segment BE connects from B to point E on AC; AD and BE intersect at F. Through E, draw a segment EG parallel to the base BC, intersecting AD at G, and in the figure G is above F. Reasoning: AD and BE are medians of triangle ABC, so D is the midpoint of BC, E is the midpoint of AC, and F is the centroid. Therefore on median AD there is AF:FD=2:1, that is, AF=2DF. Because EG ∥ BC, and E is the midpoint of AC, so in triangle ADC, △AGE ∼ △ADC, obtaining GE/DC=AE/AC=1/2. Also because D is the midpoint of BC, DC=BD, therefore GE/BD=1/2, that is, BD/GE=2. Since EG ∥ BC, and DB is on BC, EG ∥ DB; at the same time GF and DF are both on AD, and EF and BF are both on BE, therefore △GEF ∼ △DBF. From the similarity ratio, DF/GF=BD/GE=2. Given GF=2, so DF=2×2=4. By the centroid property AF=2DF=8, hence AD=AF+DF=8+4=12. Because ∠BAC=90°, BC is the hypotenuse of right triangle ABC, and AD is the median to hypotenuse BC, so AD=BC/2, therefore BC=2AD=24.
